## At a Glance

I should give a massive disclaimer up front the okonomiyaki is an amazing Japanese dish that this is based on but I'm sure isn't doing it justice. But regardless a cabbage and egg pancake with various sauces on top is hard to go wrong with and is very nourishing! But go find a real recipe if you want an actually authentic dish and support a Japanese creator. 

## Ingredients

Combine: 

- Eggs
- Diced cabbage 
- Some flour (a couple tablespoons) 
- Salt

For serving (whatever floats your boat): 

- Mayo 
- Ketchup 
- Green onions
- Toasted seseme seads 
- Seaweed
- okonomiyaki sauce 
- Mae ploy sauce

## Instructions

Mix the pancake mixture together, you want the egg to coat the cabbage but it doesn't need to be a "batter" consistency, just coating it is good enough. 

Cook at least 5 min on each side with a cover on the pan so the cabbage is steamed. 

Add desired toppings and eat.
